verdict.rationale: The product is fundamentally API-driven (REST endpoints for tokens, credentials, purchase-intent instructions) and ships a sandbox with 'evaluation registration' enabling automated test transactions, plus a TypeScript agent-toolkit/MCP server that developers can script against — all consistent with headless automation. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD pipelines, test automation frameworks, or scripted end-to-end examples beyond manual sandbox sign-up. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides, automated test-suite examples, and evidence of non-interactive/headless execution beyond the API-first design.
